scope: Reference phase-label diagnosis and additional independent measurements only; no C2-B/C3 runtime implementation
domain_and_thresholds: Use ../c2a-pr76/protocol.json unchanged; keep original results and all failed checks

phase_audit.version_comparison_role: diagnostic, never an automatic replacement oracle
phase_audit.cases: all baseline binary states and pure TP states, including originally excluded states
phase_audit.independent_algebra: PR polynomial and homogeneous composition Gibbs ordering; not a new flash solver or global mixture stability proof

joins: exact reported temperature and liquid propane mole fraction for VLE; keep unmatched pressure rows as unpaired, no interpolation
vle_selection: paired rows: baseline T/P/z with z=(x+y)/2; retain every exclusion; bubble P and y plus TP x/y/beta
gas_density_selection: n-butane: original measurement T/P domain; generic Fluid branch by measured density relative to frozen critical density; saturation rows by T and measured saturation P, no inferred pressure for scoring
policy: New sources may extend evidence but cannot erase failures, relax criteria, fit parameters, relabel raw reference outputs, or authorize a validated domain.
